concierge.title: Not sure which villa is yours?
concierge.body: Answer four short questions — who is travelling, the mood you want, and your budget — and we will put forward the three villas that fit.

help.title: Need help planning?
help.body: Our team answers within one working day, in English, German, or Russian. Ask about a specific villa, a long stay, or anything the listing does not cover.

booking.a: Send an inquiry with your dates and we confirm availability, the final quote, and the deposit by email. Nothing is charged until you accept.

payment.a: A deposit secures the dates; the balance is due before arrival. Prices are held in euros and shown in your chosen currency at the current rate.

cancellation.a: Each villa carries its own terms, stated on the villa page before you book. We confirm them in writing with your booking.

concierge.q: Can you arrange transfers and a chef?
concierge.a: Yes. Airport transfers, a private chef, boat days, and car hire can all be added — tell us in your inquiry and we will price it with the stay.

whyUs.title: Why Villa Collection?
whyUs.subtitle: A great holiday does not have to be overpriced — we stand by that.
whyUs.trustBadge: Trusted villa experts · Clear pricing in your currency

price.title: Transparent pricing
price.body: Every card shows the real total from our live cache — discounts included before you inquire.

support.title: Human support
support.body: Real people reply within one working day in English, German, or Russian.

curated.title: Curated only
curated.body: Featured, offer, and best-value rails are hand-flagged — never auto-filled noise.

discountCta.title: Get a discount
discountCta.body: Message us on WhatsApp with your dates and group size — we will match the best offer we can.

footer.paymentsNote: Prices in EUR · Display currency at checkout
